title: Blue Lightning Warrior Poses
description: Four sequential poses of a female character with short silver hair wearing a blue armored outfit with spiked shoulder pads and boots. The panels show her summoning and intensifying blue electrical energy, from holding a small orb to unleashing a massive burst of lightning and energy flames from her body against a solid pink background.
prompt: A four-panel sequence on a solid hot pink background showing the same female character with short silver-white hair and intense expression. She wears a form-fitting blue battle suit with armored shoulder pads, knee pads, and heavy boots with blue ribbons. In the first panel she holds a swirling blue energy orb, in the second she raises both hands crackling with lightning, in the third she is engulfed in a massive blue energy explosion with flames and electricity, and in the final panel she stands powerfully with residual sparks. Painted in a vibrant anime-influenced digital art style with dramatic lighting.
